entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To check an order status, press 1. For returns or exchanges, press 2. For all other inquiries, please stay on the line.
Unbelievable. Just get me a person. NOW.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. I can hear the frustration in your voice. How can I help you today?
Yeah, you can help me by doing your job! I bought this helmet a while back and I need to return it. I want a full refund, and I want it processed immediately. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into starting a return for you. To make sure I'm understanding correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?

It's the color! I hate the color, it looked completely different on your website. The box is unopened, it's been sitting here forever. Honestly, I consider it a safety issue. The color is distracting. I'm not wearing it.
I see, thank you for clarifying that. I just need to pull up your account to check the policy. Could I get your full name and order number?

It's Mark Caldwell, order 788-B45. Look, if you give me any trouble on this, I'm going straight to your manager and then I'm lighting you up on every review site I can find. I expect better from a company that sells premium gear.
Thank you for that information, Mr. Caldwell. One moment... Okay, I have your order. I see you purchased the Trail Helmet 70 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
There's nothing to confirm! Just process the return.

You are absolutely correct, Mr. Caldwell. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. You are well within that window, so I can process this for a full refund right now. No problem at all.
Oh. Well... it's about damn time something went right. So what's next?

I have just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. And Mr. Caldwell, I see here that you're a VIP member with us. I sincerely apologize for the frustration this has caused you. To thank you for your patience, I've gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your account for your next purchase.
Fifty dollars? Really? Okay... well, that's... that's actually pretty good. Thank you, Diana. I appreciate you taking care of that.
Of course, Mr. Caldwell. We value your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
